long_biography.plain_text:
Industrial businessman Franco Repetto's Unitex interests include British manufacturers that turn polyester yarn into finished lifting and safety equipment. Marling Leek supplies woven webbing, while Miller Weblift makes slings and load restraints and RidgeGear produces equipment for working at height. Locating these businesses together allowed materials and finished products to move through a common production site.

Unitex UK's managers also reorganised the factory floor to reduce clutter and keep materials flowing. After a major clear-out, they introduced replenishment signals at different stages of production and extended the system to suppliers. A team drawn from several departments helped plan the combination of sling and harness manufacturing within one production unit.
